connector.name: Ignition MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Inductive Automation Ignition: tags, alarms, history, and Perspective
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ignition-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jsgorana account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IGNITION_BRIDGE_SECRET
env.description: HMAC secret shared with the mcp-bridge WebDev project; enables live tag/alarm/history/Perspective tools

env.name: IGNITION_ALLOW_WRITES
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable mutating tools (each call still requires confirm=true)
